oe_dyn2_is_eligible_realm = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		is_ai = no
		is_great_power = yes
		country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
		num_locations >= 20
	}
}

oe_dyn2_is_great_dynasty_member = {
	has_ruler = yes
	OR = {
		ruler = {
			has_dynasty = yes
			OR = {
				dynasty = dynasty:palaiologos_dynasty
				dynasty = dynasty:borjigin_dynasty
				dynasty = dynasty:habsburg_dynasty
				dynasty = dynasty:ottomans_dynasty
				dynasty = dynasty:rtr_ming_zhu_dynasty
				dynasty = dynasty:bagrationi_dynasty
				dynasty = dynasty:valois_dynasty
				dynasty = dynasty:bourbon_dynasty
			}
		}
		has_or_had_tag = TIM
		has_reform = government_reform:timurid_empire
	}
}

oe_dyn2_has_school_religion = {
	exists = religion
	OR = {
		religion = religion:sunni
		religion = religion:shia
		religion = religion:ibadi
		religion = religion:hindu
	}
}

oe_dyn2_has_elite_heir_education = {
	has_heir = yes
	heir = {
		OR = {
			has_child_education = oe_dyn2_edu_porphyro_rhetoric
			has_child_education = oe_dyn2_edu_neoclassical_crown_academy
			has_child_education = oe_dyn2_edu_turkopersian_adab
			has_variable = oe_dyn2_elite_pupil
		}
	}
}

oe_dyn2_can_dynastic_compact = {
	government_type = government_type:monarchy
	has_ruler = yes
	ruler = { has_dynasty = yes }
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_dec_compact_cd }
}

oe_dyn2_can_language_academy = {
	exists = capital
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_dec_academy_cd }
